accessibility.description: The Windows and iOS editions have built-in screen-reader support. Windows players report completing runs, with an older report identifying inaccessible hover tooltips. The developer also confirms iOS accessibility and says typing is optional. An iOS VoiceOver player reports extensive play but describes accidental action selection after Continue in a 2022 build. Resolution of these older issues has not been independently verified.
